summary: The same assertion supported by evidence it did not already rest on promotes a candidate to corroborated; the same ref twice does not

coordination.notes: Extends the claim store rather than adding a second path to the same records. The match is on the triple (subject, predicate, value) because two claims differing in value are two assertions however alike they look, and terminal claims are excluded so corroborating something a person rejected cannot quietly undo the rejection. The worker's deterministic recorder tries corroboration before creation, so a divergence noticed again from a different event strengthens one claim instead of filling the review list with copies of one disagreement - which is what gives this a caller in the running app rather than only in a test.
coordination.deviations: aiWorker.ts is outside the increment's touches list; it is where the caller had to go, for the reason above.
